summary: Phase 31 Pass C frontend-only validation. CRITICAL P0 found: AssignmentCreateDrawer.jsx is incomplete — references pendingDraft/setPendingDraft/draftTimerRef/_readDraft/_writeDraft/_clearDraft but never declares them. Dispatch board crashes with ReferenceError 'pendingDraft is not defined' on first paint as soon as the drawer mounts. Other Pass C items verified green: HrPayrollVariance restore prompt restores on reload, NewInspection loads cleanly, NewDailyReport load-trace renders 'Loaded from Paving Crew A · edit anything as needed.' after Use Setup, DriverShift breakdown-proof staging path is correct (stagePhoto on network throw + 5xx, toast 'Photo saved on this device · will send when online.', flushStaged on 2xx), i18n strings present, operator quick-test card doc exists.

ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError: pendingDraft is not defined. The file references pendingDraft/setPendingDraft/draftTimerRef/_readDraft/_writeDraft/_clearDraft at lines 376–414, 562–563, 626–631, but: useState for [pendingDraft, setPendingDraft] is NOT declared (form-state block at lines 270–303 jumps straight from setNote to the reset-on-open useEffect). useRef for draftTimerRef is NOT declared. Helper functions _readDraft / _writeDraft / _clearDraft are NOT defined anywhere in the module (grep confirms 0 definitions, 1+ uses each). The drawer is mounted on the dispatch board at all times (open prop drives behavior, not mounting), so the body's <DraftRestorePrompt pendingDraft={pendingDraft} … /> at line 627 throws at render, taking the entire /dispatch-portal/board page down to the React red error overlay. Pass C wiring 1 is non-functional and is currently a P0 regression for the Dispatch Portal — admins cannot reach the board until this is fixed.

Restore prompt + restore behavior work, but the 'hr-pv-draft-pill' did not appear during the 2.5s typing window in the test run. May be timing-sensitive (pill flashes briefly during the saving transition and disappears once 'saved'). Not blocking — restore on reload was confirmed working.

rca_of_the_issue: ROOT CAUSE: AssignmentCreateDrawer.jsx was edited in this iteration to add Phase 31 Pass C draft restore, but only the *consumers* of the draft state were added (autosave useEffect, restore/discard callbacks, _clearDraft on submit, <DraftRestorePrompt /> mount in body). The *producers* — useState([pendingDraft, setPendingDraft]), useRef(draftTimerRef), the _readDraft/_writeDraft/_clearDraft helper definitions, and the load-on-open useEffect — were never written into the file. Static grep proves it: 0 definitions for any of the three helper functions and 0 useState/useRef declarations for the new identifiers. REPRODUCTION: multi-login → save admin+dispatch tokens to localStorage → goto /dispatch-portal/board → React red overlay 'pendingDraft is not defined at AssignmentCreateDrawer'. MITIGATION: add the missing 25–40 lines (see action_items).
